title: NASA's Mars Parachute Opened at Nearly Twice the Speed of Sound

scenes.text: NASA's Mars parachute opened at nearly twice the speed of sound.
It opened in less than half a second.
In testing, the force on it peaked at 67,000 pounds.
That's about the weight of 16 family cars.
The canopy is 70 feet wide, and it slowed the Perseverance rover over Mars in 2021.
Before it opened, the capsule was going about 1,000 miles an hour. And it held.

description:
NASA's Perseverance parachute deploys at nearly twice the speed of sound and fully opens in less than half a second.
In testing, the peak force was about 67,000 pounds.
Would you trust it with your life?
first_comment: Would you trust a parachute at twice the speed of sound?
